channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Briante Weber | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Briante Weber from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bill Neff on Pat Riley, Adam Simon, Andy Elisburg, Briante Weber
item.description:
Neff said of player development.

“They’re the gold standard. I don’t see how you can turn down Miami considering the pipeline, the amount of attention — starting at the top with Pat Riley, [general manager] Andy Elisburg, and most of all [vice president/basketball operations] Adam Simon — that they have shown with this kind of player. All things being equal, I pick Miami, because they will be the best at it, them and Toronto. “When Miami shows interest, you listen and they were the first one to show interest. It gets your attention. Great system. They train their coaches. I had Briante Weber there. If I could pick any place for a G-League guy to go, it would be Miami.”

Bill Neff on Pat Riley, Adam Simon, Andy Elisburg, Briante Weber, Jan 10, 2020. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Bob Myers on Briante Weber
item.description:
Bob Myers:

“Well, Briante is on his second 10-day and it’s really a 12-day because (it has to last three games). That’ll give us more time to evaluate him push it past the deadline. So we’ll see who was or was not traded and who might or might not be a candidate for a buyout. The buyout market is always fluid. It’s unpredictable. Often times you hear a player’s name and that doesn’t come to fruition or conversely, you’ll not have thought of a possibility and that pops up. So technically, having let (Anderson) Varejao go, we have a spot. (Briante) Weber currently has it. We can be flexible. So we’ll see what happens. It’s kind of hard to speculate on the buyout market because it’s somewhat unpredictable.”

Bob Myers on Briante Weber, Feb 15, 2017. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Briante Weber
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Briante Weber playing tonight:

“I don't think he's going to step into the rotation, but I'd like to get him out there.”

Steve Kerr on Briante Weber, Feb 4, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Okaro White on Keith Benson, Briante Weber
item.description:
“It’s just funny how it works here. Even last year with the team they had with the kind of players they had, no one got a call up but Briante. But hands down. Seeing it in practice and seeing it in games, hands down Briante is an NBA player and Keith Benson. I think it’s only a matter of time.”

Okaro White on Keith Benson, Briante Weber, Jan 19, 2017. Source: Palm Beach Post.
